title: Rajkumar Hirani Finally Comes to Streaming. And He Brought His Son, His Circuit, and a Hacker War in Goa.
excerpt: Pritam and Pedro drops on JioHotstar on July 3 — the man with a 100% box-office record makes his OTT debut, launches son Vir, and reunites with Arshad Warsi for the first time since Lage Raho Munna Bhai.
body:
At the trailer launch in a five-star Mumbai ballroom, a cyber-security expert pulled a journalist's phone out of thin air and hacked it live in front of the room. The crowd gasped. And somewhere in that gasp was the whole pitch for **Pritam and Pedro** — the idea that the scariest crime of our time isn't a gun to the head, it's a stranger who already knows your password. Then **Shreya Ghoshal** walked out and sang *Piya Piya Piya*, and the evening tilted from cyber-thriller into something warmer. That tonal swing — danger one minute, heart the next — is the most Rajkumar Hirani thing imaginable.

<youtube>https://youtube.com/watch?v=4Zuh9uuzBE0</youtube>

Because yes: this is finally it. **Rajkumar Hirani**, the man behind *Munna Bhai*, *3 Idiots*, *PK* and *Dunki*, the filmmaker with a near-mythical 100 percent success rate, is making his streaming debut. After two decades of guarding his output like a jeweller, Hirani is on JioHotstar on **July 3** — and he's not arriving quietly.



> **"One fan said it best in the trailer comments, sighing about JioHotstar access from abroad: *"But what can I do to get Jio Hotstar when not living in India???"* Sort out your subscription now."**


> "I think all actors who get a chance to work with Raju are blessed really. I have been fortunate to do that twice, and this is the third time." — Arshad Warsi


![Shreya Ghoshal — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/a/a0/Shreya_Ghoshal_Behindwoods_Gold_Icons_Awards_2023_%28cropped%29.jpg)


That third time matters. The last time **Arshad Warsi** stood on a Hirani set, he was Circuit, the most beloved sidekick in modern Hindi cinema, in *Lage Raho Munna Bhai* back in 2006. Twenty years on, he plays **Inspector Pedro Gonsalves**, a gut-instinct old-school cop handed a humiliating punishment transfer to the cyber cell. Warsi doesn't act blessed — he acts effortless, and at the launch he stole the entire show with one-liners, including the instantly meme-able *"Baap ki koi izzat nahin hoti hai, chahe aapka baap Rajkumar Hirani kyun na ho!"*

Which brings us to the real story underneath the story. The son in question is **Vir Hirani**, making his acting debut as **Pritam Parker**, a young tech prodigy and hacker who reluctantly partners with Pedro. It's a tender, slightly terrifying thing to watch a father launch his child on his own most prestigious platform — and Hirani knows it. Vir, asked if Warsi ever bullied him on set, gave the most disarming answer of the night: "The only time I would feel bullied was when he would kill it in one take while I would need 10 takes to get it right." That's not a quote a publicist writes. That's a real first-timer, and it's charming.

The trailer itself is set against Goa — sun, susegad, and a kidnapping. Pedro and Pritam are chalk and cheese, thrown together to chase a dangerous cybercriminal who has snatched a minister's son. And the villain is the trailer's sharpest casting flex: **Vikrant Massey**, fresh off *12th Fail*, playing menace with a quiet, watchful cruelty as a character named Martin. He looks genuinely unsettling — the kind of antagonist who never raises his voice because he's already inside your bank account. Round it out with **Boman Irani** and **Mona Singh**, two more Hirani-universe regulars, and *Pritam and Pedro* feels less like a debut than a family reunion.


Director **Avinash Arun** — of *Killa*, *Three of Us* and *Paatal Lok* — is the smartest hire here. Arun shoots atmosphere like few others in the country, and pairing his moody, lived-in eye with Hirani's sentimental engine could be the show's secret weapon. The writing room (Hirani, longtime collaborator Abhijat Joshi, and Suyash Trivedi) traces the idea back to the COVID lockdown, when the Mumbai Cyber Cell approached Hirani to make something on cybercrime. He met cyber expert Amit Dubey — the man doing live hacking demos at the launch — and the premise crystallised. And then there's the cameo everyone is whispering about: Warsi all but confirmed **Sanjay Dutt** turns up. Munnabhai energy, fully assembled.

For the diaspora, the where-to-watch is the only frustrating part. *Pritam and Pedro* streams exclusively on **JioHotstar** from July 3 — which means **Hotstar / Disney+ Hotstar** internationally for viewers in the US, UK and Canada (US subscribers will find it under the Hotstar add-on). One fan said it best in the trailer comments, sighing about JioHotstar access from abroad: *"But what can I do to get Jio Hotstar when not living in India???"* Sort out your subscription now. A Hirani comeback only happens so often — and this one comes wrapped in nostalgia, a debutant son, and a hacker who's already in your phone.
